fun_fact: The ones who are most impacted by climate change are often those who have contributed least to it. Sounds unfair, no? That's why people often talk about 'Climate justice'. It most recently came in the news when Nepal demanded climate justice and compensation after the terrible tragedy it saw. [Read here](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/9/why-nepal-is-demanding-climate-justice-and-compensation-after-deadly-floods)
